description: Serverless decomposed. Lambda execution model, cold starts, provisioned concurrency, SnapStart, Cloud Run (Knative), edge functions (Workers), Fargate, serverless patterns (fanout, queue-based decoupling).

sub_mechanisms.name: Lambda_micro_VM
sub_mechanisms.definition: Firecracker microVM per Lambda environment. Shared across invocations until idle.
sub_mechanisms.why: Strong isolation (VM boundary). Fast boot (~125ms). Underpins AWS Lambda + Fargate. Open-sourced by AWS.

sub_mechanisms.name: Lambda_execution_environment_reuse
sub_mechanisms.definition: Container reused across invocations. /tmp + global variables persist.
sub_mechanisms.why: Warm invocation amortises init. Use globals for DB connections, cached data. Don't rely on persistence (env may be terminated).

sub_mechanisms.name: Lambda_SnapStart
sub_mechanisms.definition: Snapshot of post-init JVM state. Restored on cold start instead of fresh boot.
sub_mechanisms.why: Java cold starts 500ms-2s reduced to 100ms. Limited to Java currently. Innovative approach to cold start.

sub_mechanisms.name: Cloud_Run_container_based
sub_mechanisms.definition: Run any HTTP-serving container. Scale 0 to N based on requests. Cold starts ~500ms-2s.
sub_mechanisms.why: Container portability + serverless ops. No code changes. More flexible than Lambda. Knative open-source standard.

sub_mechanisms.name: Cloud_Run_jobs
sub_mechanisms.definition: Run-to-completion containers. Replacement for Cloud Functions for batch.
sub_mechanisms.why: Serverless batch. Pay only when running. Use for ETL, scheduled jobs, processing.

sub_mechanisms.name: Cloudflare_Workers_isolates
sub_mechanisms.definition: V8 isolates (Chrome's JS engine). 100s of isolates per process. Sub-millisecond startup.
sub_mechanisms.why: Much lighter than containers/VMs. Trade: no native code, no filesystem, CPU time limited. Designed for edge.

sub_mechanisms.name: Workers_KV_storage
sub_mechanisms.definition: Eventually-consistent KV store at edge. Reads near-zero latency; writes 60s globally.
sub_mechanisms.why: Edge-co-located storage. Foundation for stateful edge logic. Cloudflare model: distinct storage for distinct consistency.

sub_mechanisms.name: Durable_Objects
sub_mechanisms.definition: Cloudflare: per-key singleton with strong consistency + transactional storage. Each object has location.
sub_mechanisms.why: Stateful edge. Strong consistency at cost of locality. Used for sessions, real-time coordination, leader-like patterns.

sub_mechanisms.name: Fargate_managed_pods
sub_mechanisms.definition: AWS: containers without managing EC2. Per-pod resources, pay per second.
sub_mechanisms.why: Bridges EC2 + Lambda. Container portability + serverless ops. Slightly more expensive than EC2 at high utilisation.

sub_mechanisms.name: queue_based_serverless_decoupling
sub_mechanisms.definition: Producer → queue → Lambda consumer. Spike absorbed by queue.
sub_mechanisms.why: Lambda concurrency limits + queue buffering. SQS + Lambda standard pattern. Decouples bursty producers from rate-limited Lambdas.

sub_mechanisms.name: fanout_pattern_serverless
sub_mechanisms.definition: SNS topic → many SQS queues → many Lambdas. Single event triggers parallel processing.
sub_mechanisms.why: Decoupled fanout. Each subscriber processes independently. Failure isolation. Standard event-driven architecture.

sub_mechanisms.name: step_functions_orchestration
sub_mechanisms.definition: AWS Step Functions: visual workflow. State machine across Lambdas + AWS services.
sub_mechanisms.why: Complex serverless workflows. Retries, branching, parallel execution. Distributed map for batch. Alternative to in-Lambda orchestration.

derivation_rules.name: serverless_amortises_when_traffic_spiky
derivation_rules.why: Provisioned: pay for peak even when idle. Serverless: pay per execution. Idle 90% of time = serverless cheaper. Crossover at sustained ~50% utilisation.

derivation_rules.name: edge_isolates_beat_containers_for_cold_start
then: V8 isolates (Workers) beat Lambda/Cloud Run cold starts
derivation_rules.why: Lambda cold ~125ms; Cloud Run ~500ms+; Workers sub-ms. For interactive UX globally, isolates win. Trade: programming model constraints.

derivation_rules.name: queue_decouples_serverless_consumer_from_producer
derivation_rules.why: Direct: bursts overwhelm Lambda concurrency limit. With queue: burst goes into queue, Lambda processes at sustainable rate. Standard pattern.

derivation_rules.name: Lambda_payload_limit_forces_S3_handoff
if: payload exceeds 6 MB sync / 256 KB async
derivation_rules.why: Hard limit. Common pattern: upload to S3 → trigger Lambda with key → Lambda reads. Pre-signed URLs for client direct upload.

derivation_rules.name: Step_Functions_replaces_complex_in_Lambda_orchestration
then: Step Functions cleaner than chained Lambdas
derivation_rules.why: In-Lambda orchestration: complex code, retry logic, error handling. Step Functions: declarative state machine, built-in retry, visual debug. Standard at AWS scale.
